summary: Iteration 3 — scheduler / source importers (scan + import + duplicate) / branding backfill / QCS / admin tabs. 15/17 backend tests PASS; all frontend flows PASS. Two real backend bugs found: (1) /uploads/branded/* not reachable via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (ingress only forwards /api/*); (2) branding backfill is NOT idempotent when brand_vehicle_images returns 0 paths — vehicles keep being re-processed on every call.

critical.issue: Public URL routes /uploads/* to the frontend container (port 3000) and returns text/html (frontend SPA shell), not the image file. Only /api/* is forwarded to backend by the Kubernetes ingress. Branded vehicle photos referenced from vehicle.local_images=['/uploads/branded/<x>.jpg'] will 404/HTML in production. Internal http://localhost:8001/uploads/branded/<x>.jpg DOES return image/jpeg correctly. Fix: mount StaticFiles under /api/uploads (i.e. app.mount('/api/uploads', StaticFiles(...))) and emit local_images as '/api/uploads/branded/<x>.jpg', or use the existing FileResponse pattern (/api/auto/uploads/<...>) inside the auto router.

Idempotency broken. Spec says 'a second call must return processed:0 (no force flag)'. Observed: first call → processed=2/branded_images=1; immediate second call → processed=2/branded_images=1 (same vehicles re-processed). Root cause: in auto_routes.admin_backfill_branding the local_images field is only updated when brand_vehicle_images() returns a non-empty list (`if local_paths:`). If brand_vehicle_images returns [] (e.g. all source images fail to download), the vehicle keeps source_images set + local_images empty -> matches the same query again on next run. Fix: always set a 'branded_attempted_at' marker (or write local_images=[] when run failed), so the idempotent guard excludes vehicles already attempted.

minor.issue: Returns 200 OK with `ok:false, error:'...', items:[]` for known sources when the source raises (e.g. Manheim/Pickles network error). That matches the agent-to-agent note (acceptable), but it's worth surfacing the source name & a 5xx-style error code instead of a 200 to make UI error reporting cleaner.

When brand_vehicle_images partially succeeds (some images return [] paths), branded_images undercounts and processed doesn't reflect real vehicles updated. Consider returning {processed, updated, failed} separately for clarity.

integration_issues.flow: Vehicle gallery / catalog when local_images uses /uploads/branded/...
integration_issues.issue: Linked to the /uploads ingress bug above — branded photo URLs will render as broken images in production.

action_items: Fix /uploads static mount routing: either mount under /api/uploads, or expose a /api/auto/uploads/{path:path} FileResponse endpoint. Then update brand_vehicle_images / admin_backfill_branding to write that prefixed path into vehicle.local_images.

Fix branding idempotency: when admin_backfill_branding processes a vehicle, ALWAYS persist a marker (e.g. branded_attempted_at=utcnow() and/or local_images=[] on failure) so the same vehicle isn't picked up again without force=true.
Backfill existing vehicle rows whose local_images already use '/uploads/branded/...' so they point at the new public prefix once routing is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_routes.py is now ~1090 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Split into auto_public_routes.py / auto_admin_routes.py / auto_admin_sources_routes.py / auto_admin_images_routes.py / auto_stripe_routes.py.

admin_sources_import duplicates a lot of orchestrator logic (re-instantiating the importer, calling find_duplicate) instead of using ImportOrchestrator.run_one; if scan and import diverge on normalisation rules, duplicate detection will silently break. Prefer extending ImportOrchestrator with an ids_filter.
auto_scheduler.start() uses asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated in Python 3.12+. Use asyncio.create_task() inside an async startup hook or asyncio.get_running_loop().
scheduler exposes last_run_at/last_result but no last_error — when a refresh fails it's only logged. Consider persisting last_error so the admin tab can show it.

admin_backfill_branding builds an open-ended query that selects ALL vehicles with images and no local_images. For larger DBs add a hard cap and skip vehicles whose source URLs already point at our own /uploads/ host.

failing_tests: test_local_images_served — /uploads/* not reachable via public URL (see action items)
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (ingress): The Kubernetes ingress only routes /api/* to backend:8001; /uploads/* is currently served by the React dev server (port 3000) which returns the SPA index.html. The StaticFiles mount at app.mount('/uploads', ...) IS correctly serving files at localhost:8001/uploads/branded/<x>.jpg with content-type image/jpeg, confirming the backend is fine and the issue is purely ingress + URL prefixing. Bug 2 (idempotency): admin_backfill_branding only persists vehicle changes when brand_vehicle_images returns non-empty local_paths; vehicles whose remote images all fail (e.g. transient network errors, Unsplash 429, AI overlay error) never get a 'completed' marker, so the same query keeps matching them on every subsequent call. The fix is to ALWAYS mark vehicles as processed (e.g. set local_images=[] or branded_attempted_at=utcnow()) and exclude already-attempted ones from the default query unless force=true.
